daily.today_energy: Your magnetic energy is peak today, Leo. The universe is basically handing you a VIP pass to authentic connections and meaningful moments. Trust the vibes you're picking up on.
daily.love: Someone's noticing your glow, whether that's a crush or your ride-or-die crew. Today's about letting people in without the armor. Vulnerability hits different when you're this confident.
daily.career: Your ideas are hitting harder than usual—this is your moment to speak up in meetings or pitch that project you've been sitting on. The energy supports bold moves and creative solutions.
daily.health: Your body's asking for movement and sunlight today. Whether it's a walk, dancing in your room, or yoga, your physical energy craves expression. Listen to what feels good.

weekly.overview: This week's cosmic energy is asking you to step into your authenticity. Venus is vibing with your sector of self-expression, so lean into what makes you feel most *you*. Expect some pleasant surprises that remind you why people are drawn to your light.
weekly.love: Whether you're coupled or single, this is about magnetic energy. If you're with someone, have a real conversation—the kind where you actually listen. If you're solo, your confidence is literally the main character energy right now. Trust the vibe.
weekly.career: Your creative momentum is real this week. This is the time to pitch that idea you've been sitting on or take on a project that excites you. The universe is supporting bold moves, but make sure you're not overcommitting. Quality over quantity, always.
weekly.health: Your body's asking for movement that feels good, not punishment. Dance, walk, stretch—whatever brings you joy. Energy levels might dip midweek, so honor that by resting without guilt. Hydration is lowkey your secret weapon right now.
